pca resource community data
```{r}
data("resourcecommunitydata")
data("resourcecommunityindex")

rescom.index <- resourcecommunityindex %>% 
  dplyr::rename(index=indice, direction=direccionalidad)

rescom.data.catch <- resourcecommunitydata %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("captura", NOM_LOC)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NOM_LOC = gsub("_captura","",NOM_LOC))

rescom.names <- rescom.data.catch %>% 
  dplyr::select(name=NOM_LOC)

rescom.nosp <- rescom.data.catch %>% 
  dplyr::select(-NOM_LOC) #eliminate column with row names, needs only data values

#scale life history traits  
maxs <- apply(rescom.nosp, 2, max)
mins <- apply(rescom.nosp, 2, min)

scaled.rescom <- scale(rescom.nosp, center = mins, scale = maxs - mins)  %>% 
  tidyr::as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::bind_cols(rescom.names, .) 


factor.scores.rescom.catch <- pca_factor(thisdata = scaled.rescom, datasetname = "recursos_comunidades_captura", namesdata = rescom.names, index= rescom.index)

rescom.data.value <- resourcecommunitydata %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("valor", NOM_LOC)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NOM_LOC = gsub("_valor","",NOM_LOC))

rescom.names <- rescom.data.value %>% 
  dplyr::select(name=NOM_LOC)

rescom.nosp <- rescom.data.value %>% 
  dplyr::select(-NOM_LOC) #eliminate column with row names, needs only data values

#scale life history traits  
maxs <- apply(rescom.nosp, 2, max)
mins <- apply(rescom.nosp, 2, min)

scaled.rescom <- scale(rescom.nosp, center = mins, scale = maxs - mins)  %>% 
  tidyr::as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::bind_cols(rescom.names, .) 

factor.scores.rescom.value <- pca_factor(thisdata = scaled.rescom, datasetname = "recursos_comunidades_valor", namesdata = rescom.names, index= rescom.index)

#calculate by ratio

rescom.catch <- rescom.data.catch %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=2:7, names_to = "community", values_to = "catch")

rescom.value<- rescom.data.value %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=2:7, names_to = "community", values_to = "value")

rescom.ratio <- dplyr::left_join(rescom.catch, rescom.value, by = c("NOM_LOC", "community")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(catch_ratio=value/catch) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(catch_ratio=dplyr::if_else(is.nan(catch_ratio),0,catch_ratio)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-catch, -value) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=community, values_from = catch_ratio)
     
rescom.names <- rescom.ratio %>% 
  dplyr::select(name=NOM_LOC)

rescom.nosp <- rescom.ratio %>% 
  dplyr::select(-NOM_LOC) #eliminate column with row names, needs only data values

#scale life history traits  
maxs <- apply(rescom.nosp, 2, max)
mins <- apply(rescom.nosp, 2, min)

scaled.rescom <- scale(rescom.nosp, center = mins, scale = maxs - mins)  %>% 
  tidyr::as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::bind_cols(rescom.names, .) 


factor.scores.rescom.ratio <- pca_factor(thisdata = scaled.rescom, datasetname = "recursos_comunidades_ratio", namesdata = rescom.names, index= rescom.index)

```

# Visualization: Heatmap for Resource-Community Ratio
```{r resource_community_ratio_heatmap}
# Order locations alphabetically
rescom_order <- rescom.ratio %>%
  dplyr::pull(NOM_LOC) %>%
  sort()

heatmap.plot.rescom.ratio <- rescom.ratio %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -NOM_LOC, names_to = "community", values_to = "ratio") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    NOM_LOC = factor(stringr::str_to_title(NOM_LOC), levels = stringr::str_to_title(rescom_order)),
    community = stringr::str_wrap(stringr::str_to_title(community), width = 10)
  ) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = community, y = NOM_LOC, fill = ratio)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[1],
    mid = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[6],
    high = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[11],
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Proporcion valor/captura"
  ) +
#  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(ratio, 2)), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Comunidad",
    y = "Localidad",
    caption = "El azul mas obscuro indica mayor valor por unidad de captura"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggplot2::ggsave("rescom_ratio_heatmap.png", heatmap.plot.rescom.ratio, path = here::here("outputs", "figures"),
                dpi = 400, width = 10, height = 8, scale = 1)

heatmap.plot.rescom.ratio
```


pca management data
```{r}
data("managementdata")
data("managementindex")

management.index <- managementindex %>% 
  dplyr::rename(index=indice, direction=direccionalidad)

tot.permisos <- managementdata %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(recurso) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(tot_permisos=sum(no_permisos_vigentes)) 
  
management.data <- managementdata %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(recurso) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise_all(list(mean)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-no_permisos_vigentes) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(tot.permisos, by ="recurso")

man.names <- management.data %>% 
  dplyr::select(name=recurso)

management.nosp <- management.data %>% 
  dplyr::select(-recurso) #eliminate column with row names, needs only data values

#scale life history traits  
maxs <- apply(management.nosp, 2, max)
mins <- apply(management.nosp, 2, min)


scaled.management <- scale(management.nosp, center = mins, scale = maxs - mins)  %>% 
  tidyr::as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::bind_cols(man.names, .) 


factor.scores.management <- pca_factor(thisdata = scaled.management, datasetname = "manejo_pesquero", namesdata = man.names, index= management.index)



```

PCA life history 

```{r species sensitivity, include=FALSE}

data("lifehistorydata")
data("lifehistoryindex")

life.index <- lifehistoryindex %>% 
  dplyr::rename(index=indice, direction=direccionalidad)

  lf.traitsdata <- lifehistorydata %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=maxima_edad:mobilidad_adulto,names_to = "index") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=dplyr::if_else(value=="Bajo", 1,
                                       dplyr::if_else(value=="Moderado", 2,
                                                      dplyr::if_else(value=="Alto", 3, 4)))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(name = recurso) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(value=mean(value), .by=c("name", "index")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(name = toupper(name)) %>% 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=index, values_from = value)
    
life.names <- lf.traitsdata %>% 
  dplyr::select(name)


lifehistory.nosp <- lf.traitsdata %>% 
  dplyr::select(-name) 

#scale life history traits  
maxs <- apply(lifehistory.nosp, 2, max)
mins <- apply(lifehistory.nosp, 2, min)

scaled.lifehistory <- scale(lifehistory.nosp, center = mins, scale = maxs - mins) %>% 
  tidyr::as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::bind_cols(life.names, .)


factor.scores.fisheries <-pca_factor(thisdata = scaled.lifehistory, datasetname = "historia_vida", namesdata = life.names, index= life.index)




```


Plot PCAs

```{r}

result.list <- list.files(path=here::here("outputs","analysis"),pattern="factor_scores*.*", full.names= TRUE)

result.data <- lapply(result.list, readr::read_csv) 

community.data <- dplyr::bind_rows(result.data[1], result.data[2]) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()
```
# Visualization: Faceted Bar Chart (communities within each component)

```{r faceted_bar_chart}
faceted.plot <- community.data %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = name, y = PC1, fill = component)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~component, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(unique(community.data$component)), "Set2"),
    name = "Component"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Principal Component 1 Scores by Community and Component",
    x = "Community",
    y = "PC1 Score",
    caption = "Faceted view showing each component separately"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_linedraw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggplot2::ggsave("community_faceted.png", faceted.plot, path = here::here("outputs", "figures"),
                dpi = 400, width = 12, height = 8, scale = 1)
```

# Visualization: Dodged Bar Chart (direct component comparison)
```{r dodged_bar_chart}
dodged.plot <- community.data %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = name, y = PC1, fill = component)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(unique(community.data$component)), "Set2"),
    name = "Component"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Principal Component 1 Scores: Communities and Components Compared",
    x = "Community",
    y = "PC1 Score",
    caption = "Bars grouped by community, colored by component"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_linedraw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggplot2::ggsave("community_dodged.png", dodged.plot, path = here::here("outputs", "figures"),
                dpi = 400, width = 10, height = 6, scale = 1)
```

# Visualization: Heatmap (community × component matrix)
```{r heatmap}
# Sort communities by mean PC1 score (highest to lowest)

community.data.norm <- community.data %>% 
 dplyr::mutate(PC1 = (PC1 - min(PC1, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(PC1, na.rm = TRUE) - min(PC1, na.rm = TRUE)))

heatmap.plot.community <- community.data.norm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
   component = dplyr::if_else(component=="carac_socioeconomicas","Socioeconómicas","Pesquerías" ),
   name = stringr::str_to_title(name)
  ) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = component, y = name, fill = PC1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#DC143C",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#08519c",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    name = "Componente PC1"
  ) +
 # ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(PC1, 2)), size = 3, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Caracteristícas",
    y = "Comunidad",
    caption = "La intensidad del color azul indica mayor ideoneidad"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggplot2::ggsave("community_heatmap.png", heatmap.plot.community, path = here::here("outputs", "figures"),
                dpi = 400, width = 10, height = 6, scale = 1)

#promedio

#  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
 ggplot2::geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(length(resource_order))) +
  ggplot2::labs(

    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
```

heatmap.plot.resource.mean <- resource.data.norm %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_PC1=mean(PC1), .by=name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(name = forcats::fct_reorder(name, mean_PC1, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = name, y=mean_PC1, fill=name)) +
#  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
 ggplot2::geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(mean_PC1, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(length(resource_order))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Recurso pesquero",
    y = "Idoneidad",
    fill =""
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, angle = 45, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = -15, l = 0)),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggplot2::ggsave("resource_heatmap_mean.png", heatmap.plot.resource.mean, path = here::here("outputs", "figures"),
                dpi = 400, width = 15, height = 7, scale = 1)```
